Subject: Recommendations of the Signal Review Pane! (SRP) related to Whole Virion,
inactivated Coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) Vaccine) [COVAXIN]- regarding.

References: Recommendations of the Signal Review Panel (SRP) related to COVID 19
Vaccines received to this office from Immunization division vide email dated 25.01 .2023
Sir,
With reference to the subject cited above, this is to inform that the Signal Review Panel
(SRP) for vaccines under Immunization Division of MoHFW has been set up to assess
information on potential vaccine safety signals (routine and COVID-19 vaccines) using AEF!
. surveillance database.

Based on the evaluation of the AEF! related data and published medical literature SRE
has made recommendation on inclusion of the following rare adverse events in the SmPC of
Whole Virion, Inactivated Coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) Vaccine) [COVAXIN]:

e "Unknown frequency: Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS) following vaccination with

COVAXIN “in Section '4.8 Undesirable effects' of SmPC.”

This is being communicated to you to update the SmPC & Prescribing Information (Pl) as per
recommendations of SRP and submit the same to this Directorate.
Yours faithfully,
